records.summary: Repeated kills fail to repeat pet; research identifies Tarantula as once-per-character drop, not repeatable commodity farm.

source.cleaned_file: goldbound/007 - Redridge Rares That Can Make You Rich - Goldbound Episode 7.en-orig.txt
source.quote: Now, this isn't necessarily a huge win for Red Ridge specifically, but in the future, where the zones and the pools in them are more valuable, this will be a big quality of life upgrade. So, we'll definitely be casting into a few schools while we're out here, not just for a little bit of gold, but to try and reel in one of the best fishing upgrades we can for the long haul. And with a few more items, rares, and fish on our hit list, I figured it was time to circle back to an old nemesis, Null Feaster. If you remember our epic duel last episode, it gave us a proper fight. And it turns out it's still the only mob in Redidge that can. You see, Null Feaster was added after the Cataclysm, which means it doesn't follow the same Chromy time rules as the rest of Redidge. Ever since we hit level 70, we've outscaled most of the zone, except for this guy. He still hits like a current content boss. But the real reason we were tagging him was the tarantula pet, which after killing him a few more times without the drop, I did some research. And it turns out it's actually a onetime drop per character.

records.name: Redridge Tarantula pet sale

source.file: 007 - Redridge Rares That Can Make You Rich - Goldbound Episode 7.en-orig.vtt
source.cleaned_file: goldbound/007 - Redridge Rares That Can Make You Rich - Goldbound Episode 7.en-orig.txt
source.quote: You can't necessarily farm an army's worth in Goldie's future. But hey, we can still sell one, get a few gold, or we can decide to keep it and use it for battle pets. We'll see if it sells in the auction house. Otherwise, we'll probably just keep it as a battle pet. And with that wrapped up, it's been a pretty productive episode for Goldilock. So, let's head over to the local mailbox for one of my favorite moments, the fresh mailbox tally, and of course, a/played reveal. All right, straight into the mailbox. First up, we're met with 112 mails sold. And starting off, we have some standard trade goods, a few glyphs being sold, and random items we got throughout the zone. The first semi-notable transmog piece to move, the Buccaneers pants. This is a fastmoving lower ticket classic item sold for about 700 gold. Not challenge breaking, but some decent gold along the way. And we also managed to sell off our one and only red ridge tarantula, which went for 285 gold. And hey, a few extra coins in the pouch. We really can't complain. One of the biggest trade goods this round, 1,046 copper bolts sold in one go for 4,969 gold. That's a proper drop in the bucket. And scrolling down further, a second pair of Buccaneers pants sold for 667 gold. The Buccaneer set is a lower ticket highv volume transmog set that we always want to keep on the auction house. And we do have a few more trade goods trickling in and a nice little bonus one. One of our tarantula silk sashes from Chatter sold. Now we did get a lot of these. So I tossed one up at a fire sale price and it moved. But that's not the only one that moved. We had another scimitar of aon cell for 9,000 gold. Not bad at all. That's a very solid profit just from taking out a few hundred murlocs. So let's go ahead and clear out the rest. And there'll just be 12 males remaining. But of course, we have to appreciate that classic gold jingle.
